{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for severe patients and exclude those with sentinel values (-999.0)
severe_valid = trial_df[(trial_df['severity'] == 'severe') & (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0)]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients with valid data
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_valid['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_biomarker_severe)"}
